scope: Actual Small model files and actual native GPU ASR in isolated Base-key aliases only. Original production FullCapture 14s scheduling, verified getAudio PCM injection on extension control page; not a production Small registry/UI or X media-acquisition acceptance.
modelIdentityCaveat: Small arms contain all seven actual Small config/tokenizer/weights at a fixed revision. Base is only the controller/cache/RPC compatibility alias and must not be reported as the actual Small model id.
stoppingCaveat: All snapshots share the older upstream unhooked stopping contract. Every observed Small window inference was <15s, but this is not a hard deadline/stopping-adapter acceptance.
samplingCaveat: First 3 numbered test clips of 13 selected languages; one serial Mac/Chrome run per arm. Separate script-normalization views are evaluation-only. WER/CER stay separated.
memoryCaveat: Cache/model file byte sizes are measured. Chrome process/GPU peak memory was not sampled; no low-memory acceptance claim.
